title: Epimorphisms via the cokernel pair
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of $\mathcal C$ such that the pushout $Y\amalg_XY$ of $f$ along $f$ exists, with its two coprojections $i_1,i_2:Y\to Y\amalg_XY$ (so $i_1\circ f=i_2\circ f$). Then $f$ is an epimorphism ([def-galois-epi-final]) if and only if $i_1=i_2$.
